name: State-Machine Isomorphism
description: Transformed a 2-machine parallel scheduling flow-shop into a purely sequential state machine tracking a "buffer" and "idle delay". The mathematical invariant (makespan = idle time of machine 2 + sum of processing times on machine 2) is used as the new objective function. This strips all scheduling NLP cues (parallel tracks, continuous running, prerequisites) while strictly preserving the underlying mathematical structure and complexity class.
